content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD#8673: inference-service (eu-west) high 5xx rate, impact: client-facing requests failing
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty | Triggered: escalation policy=ML-Platform-Oncall, urgency=high, status=triggered
sam: ack — I'm oncall and grabbing it. opening the runbook now :zipper_mouth_face:
anya: pinging infra for potential autoscaler noise; are we seeing node eviction events?
sam: checking k8s events and pod statuses
sam: ```
kubectl -n inference get pods | grep inference
inference-deploy-5f4b8   0/3   CrashLoopBackOff   6    2m
inference-deploy-6c7a1   3/3   Running            0    10m
``` 
sam: logs show OOMKilled on one replica, others overloaded with 503s
carmen: I'm free to help, handing ownership to @carmen if sam wants to step back
sam: taking temporary ownership, but handing to @carmen for longer follow-through — carmen, you good?
carmen: taking it. I'll scale down model size and flip to fallback route. starting mitigation.
leo: FYI support reported ~12 customer error reports, no major data loss, but increased latency for embeddings
support-ops: forwarding customer IDs to SRE for postmortem tracking
carmen: applying immediate mitigation: bump replicas to 6 and enable fallback model pool
carmen: ```
kubectl scale deploy inference-deploy --replicas=6 -n inference
# toggle traffic to fallback model
redwoodctl route set inference-service --model=fallback-v1 --weight=0.6
```
anya: autoscaler metrics look noisy — CPU spike then rapid scale down. setting minReplicas=3 to avoid oscillation
sam: tracking: make a jira (INF-1428) for autoscaler tuning, and run heapdump on killed pods
carmen: mitigation holding, 5xx rate down to baseline. PD: please ack resolved? :thumbsup:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty | Incident acknowledged by carmen — status=acknowledged
support-ops: customers notified via status.redwood.ai incident update
carmen: I'll lead the post-incident review tomorrow; early hypothesis: aggressive HPA cooldown + heavy tokenization workload causing OOMs
sam: thanks all — switching to passive monitoring, will ping if it flares
incident-bot: Incident cleared from PD after 25m; auto-close scheduled in 1h unless re-opened
carmen: note for postmortem: consider prefix caching, model warm pools, and HPA stabilization window
sam: closing thread; final status: mitigated, customer impact limited to transient errors, follow-up INF-1428
(reacted :white_check_mark:)
